Foundry Colors

Every color the system uses, what it means, and keep or drop by the research's rule: a color for a meaning, never the only cue, few at once. Then the approved chat cards and PC sheet with the fonts already swapped, before and after the drops. The Action card is left out: it takes the book's look in step 5.

ColorWhat it saysProposedWhy
Page, band, rule, hairline, ink, muted inkthe surfaces and the textkeepthe neutrals; the warm dark and the parchment stay
Gold (stars, diamonds, links, the open tab, rules)structure and "you can click this"keep, as the book's bronzethe book's one accent; the two are already near (gold #d4a548 dark, bronze #d2a75a)
The stamp (the one filled button)the thing you click to actkeepa control, not a code; the research: one filled button
Tier 1 red, Tier 2 yellow-green, Tier 3 green, Critical bluethe result of a roll, at a glancekeepa working surface needs it; never alone (the word "Tier" and its number are there). Red against green is the color-blind pair: the number carries it
[V] Vigor red, [R] Resolve bluewhich Health pool a hit goes tokeepthe book keeps them
AP blue and Guard blue in text"this is a game word"drop (ink)the book dropped them; a color per keyword is the "app" sign
Boon blue, Bane red in textthe word's meaningdrop (ink)the word says it
Body, Mind, Instinct, Appeal colors; the Modifiers' colorswhich Attribute or Modifierdrop (ink)the word says it; the book dropped them
The frequency: filled pills (chat, sheet cost), a filled band (Action card), the group diamondsRound, Turn, Encounter, At-will, Dailyquiet: a small mark beside the word; pills in inkcolor with the word passes "never alone"; a filled pill is the badge the research calls the app sign. On the sheet the cost pill carries no word, so the group heading's diamond keeps the color
The Basic Actions' colored edges (At-will green, Once per round blue, Strike red)the frequency and the Strike traityour callcolor is the only cue there (a legend explains it): the research's clearest "no". Keep, replace with a letter, or drop
The trait group's colors (filled chips) and the group's name under eachRoll, Requires, Kind, Damage, Keywordsdrop the fills; the group names go with the Action card in step 5the book prints traits in black by group order
The rank's color (Minion grey, Grunt green, Standard red, Elite purple)the NPC's rank, on its name platekeepone place, with the rank's word beside it
The damage subtypes' colors and icons (Holy gold, Slash steel...)the subtypeyour callyou chose them on 2026-11-13; the icon and the two letters carry it, so the color is extra; the book prints them plain
Success green, failure red (Apply, a passed Save)the outcomekeep, consider blue for successthe research found blue in the place of green shipped for color-blind players
The Levels window's section colorswhat a section gives (an Attribute, a Frequency...)keepyou asked for them (2026-11-13: "everything looks too equal"); a builder's window, with the section's title in words
